author: Sam 2324

title: Layout is oversized
body:
Hi Team,

I hope the size / scale of the layout is adjustable. Due to numerous tasks I have added, I need to move up and down rather than having a big overall view on my whole day tasks. 

I use iPhone mini, so the maximum items at a glance are 4 only. I am fine with smaller texts but more compact view. Thanks.

author: abbymaklf

title: Review
body:
Habitminder remarkably made an good impression at the beginning, I was very stoked to make many more habits .

But it was disappointed me very much that I had to pay in order to do so. I do understand the exception, hopefully you are aware to be more realistic and considerate to you viewers.

I am not claiming that paying is not exceptional, I am suggesting that if you claim that you are an app that can help is in a way ourselves can’t, please make something more reasonable, overall this is  habitminder not a game
